title: Assay Data Ingestion and Compound Ranking
description: Ingest bioactivity assay data, compute potency/safety composite scores, and rank compounds.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

assay_csv.description: CSV file with assay data. Must include compound_id and activity columns.

potency_assay.description: Column name in CSV for the primary potency assay (e.g. IC50 against target kinase).

safety_assay.description: Column name in CSV for safety counter-screen (e.g. hERG inhibition).

potency_weight.description: Weight for potency in composite score. Safety weight = 1 - potency_weight.

herg_safe_threshold.description: hERG IC50 safety threshold in μM. Compounds below this value flagged as unsafe.

top_n.description: Number of top-ranked compounds to highlight in the report.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
